completion_data.completion_summary: Implemented all 3 Category A Zotero CLI wrapper scripts: zotero-setup.sh (4 sub-commands: --detect, --configure, --validate, --status), zotero-read.sh (9 read operations wrapping zot with JSON envelope parsing), and zotero-write.sh (4 write operations with --dry-run and --idempotency-key flags). All scripts use BASH_SOURCE[0]-relative project root resolution, the 0/1/2 exit code convention, and stderr/stdout separation.

memory_candidates.content: Zotero CLI wrapper pattern: Scripts wrapping zot (zotero-cli-cc) should use BASH_SOURCE[0]-relative ../../ path resolution (same as literature-retrieve.sh). ZOT_DATA_DIR resolution order: (1) env var, (2) specs/zotero-index.json .zot_data_dir field, (3) auto-detect common paths. JSON envelope: pass --json explicitly to zot for structured output {ok, data, meta}; extract .data or handle .error. Exit codes: 0=success, 1=runtime error, 2=not configured/not installed. PDF operations (pdf, outline, annotations) use plain text output without --json.
